name: Arabic High School Program
org: Department of Linguistics, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
what_you_do: Take a two-week beginner class in Modern Standard Arabic on campus for 2 college credits. You also join conversation tables, cooking, calligraphy and field trips. You live in a campus dorm.
who_can_apply: High school students with little or no Arabic. The page lists no grade or age rules.
pay_detail: Tuition is not listed on the pages read. There is a $25 application fee and a $250 deposit after admission. Scholarships are awarded based on financial need and/or academic merit. The page says its 2026 program was funded by a Qatar Foundation International grant.
deadline_text: Tentative application deadline April 11, 2027. Registration deadline April 26, 2027. Final payment May 28, 2027. Dates may change.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application and pay the $25 fee. Send a high school transcript, a note from a teacher and a scholarship form. Counselors email transcripts to silmw-uiuc@illinois.edu.
notes: The page says an early admission date gives a better chance at the largest scholarship. Dates and deadlines may change by spring. Contact: linguistics@illinois.edu, (217) 244-0661.
